title: Fate/Grand Order -turas réalta-
description: “In 2017, humanity will go extinct.” The vanishing of the future, observed by the Human Order Preservation Agency Chaldea, has proven that end. Assuming the cause lies in Fuyuki, a provincial city in Japan, in 2004, Chaldea attempts to identify and eliminate it through Rayshift. Two young people take on the task. Thus begins Fujimaru Ritsuka and Mash Kyrielight’s lonely war against human history.
author: Type-Moon
